positions.title: Sr Software Engineer, java services
positions.locationName: Los Angeles, California, United States · Remote
positions.description: Ad platform for Display+ and Hulu. Backend services in java Spring boot, AWS (Open Search Elastic Search, DynamoDb, SQS, Terraform).

positions.title: Sr Software Engineer, Java services
positions.locationName: San Jose, California, United States · Remote
positions.description: I worked on services to enable customers of Adobe PDF and Creative Cloud to collaborate with others, i.e. post comments, tag people, and receive notifications.  Built AWS Java Spring Boot REST APIs and event-driven systems, deployed world wide. On a team of 10, worked with multiple teams, resolved performance bottlenecks, provided production support. I supported migrating the legacy system to a next gen service, and supported data migration.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer, python services
positions.description: Backend API AWS serverless development using python AWS Lambda, DynamoDB, sqs, terraform.

positions.title: Sr Software Engineer, data pipeline [covid layoff]
positions.description: Backend engineer on Uber Eats.  Increased the month subscription adoption of Uber EATS customers by 20%. Create data pipelines to compute individual potential monthly savings, and city averages, then surface that on the app thru Golang REST service.  Python, Apache Spark, Cassandra noSQL.

positions.title: Engineer 2, Sr Software Engineer, Java services
positions.description: For TurboTax, build Java microservices, deployed on AWS for the Core Tax Services team.  Led team to migrate from monolith to AWS Java microservices; to collaborate w/ teams to build features in TurboTax (i.e. W2 & 1099 import, connect users to CPAs, integration with financial institutions). [ ReactJS, Java, Jenkins, GraphQL, Spring Boot, Cassandra noSQL, ActiveMQ queue]
